mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and CNS depressant effects; chlorpromazine may inhibit loperamide metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing loperamide levels and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS depression, anticholinergic effects, and constipation; consider dose reduction of loperamide or alternative antidiarrheal agent if concurrent use necessary.
